1.text: Zaburi ya Asafu.Imana ihagarara mu iteraniro ryayo,Icira abigira “imana” urubanza iti

2.text: “Muzageza he guca imanza zibera,Zita ku cyubahiro cy'abanyabyaha?Sela.

3.text: Muce imanza zikwiriye uworoheje n'impfubyi,Muce imanza zirenganura umunyamubabaro n'umutindi.

5.text: “Abo mbwiye nta cyo bazi, nta cyo bamenya,Bagendagenda mu mwijima,Imfatiro zose z'isi ziranyeganyega.

6.text: Ni jye wababwiye nti‘Muri imana,Mwese muri abana b'Isumbabyose.’

7.text: Ariko muzapfa nk'abantu,Muzagwa nk'umwe mu bakomeye.”

8.text: Mana, haguruka ucire isi urubanza,Kuko uzagira amahanga yose umwandu wawe.
